subject: POC kickoff — timezone bridge & split-session confirmation
messages:
From: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@tesseraai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed windows and pre-reqs

Hi team,

Thanks for coordinating — excited to get the hands-on POC started. We have a few constraints on our side (regional ops in APAC, and a short maintenance window Friday PM). Proposed kickoff windows (PT):

- Option A: Tue 9/7 10:00–12:00 PT — concentrate hands-on + routing test (preferred by product)
- Option B: Wed 9/8 16:00–18:00 PT — split session: short sync + asynchronous prompt review

Scope for the session:
- 45–60m hands-on prompt review + prompt engineering guidance
- 30m routing and integration walkthrough (routing policy, headers)
- 30m load-test smoke run (small burst only)

Pre-reqs: please confirm network egress rules (we'll need outbound to 34.120.0.0/14), and share a list of sample prompts you want us to exercise. Attached: poc-runbook-v1.pdf and loadtest-matrix.xlsx.

If the team prefers, we can do an APAC-friendly split (short hands-on for APAC morning + async follow-up). Give us a preferred slot and we'll send invites.

— Alex
Alex Zhao
Head of Platform — Tessera AI
platform-ops@tesseraai.com

Attachments: poc-runbook-v1.pdf (15KB), loadtest-matrix.xlsx (8KB)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Zhao <alex.zhao@tesseraai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows and pre-reqs

Thanks Alex — quick note: the team in APAC won't be available in Option A (they're overnight). We had a no-go on Friday maintenance, so Option B (Wed 16:00 PT) could work, but I want to propose a timezone-bridge approach to avoid excluding APAC ops:

1) Split the hands-on: a focused 45min hands-on for APAC (Tue 9/7 06:00–06:45 PT / Wed 9/8 21:00–21:45 SGT) — run routing smoke + a single prompt walkthrough.
2) Full demo + prompt review for EMEA/NA: Wed 9/8 16:00–18:00 PT as your Option B, where we'll do deeper prompt engineering and the 30m load-test smoke run.
3) We'll collect prompts beforehand and run longer load tests asynchronously outside the live session window if needed.

Marissa will lead the routing tests; Mina can own the prompt pass and capture evals. Neha — can you confirm SLA testing metrics we should capture (p50/p95 latency, error rate, token cost per request)?

If that plan looks good to you, Alex, we'll send calendar invites for both the APAC micro-session and the full NA/EMEA session. Also tagging the pre-reqs: please confirm the egress CIDR and share a short list of 6–8 canonical prompts by Friday.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
